content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Employer HR and benefits administration software and outsourcing; not hospital EHR, revenue cycle or patient engagement."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Fundraising and donor management software for nonprofits and schools; different customers and products from hospital IT."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Cloud EHR, practice software and outsourced revenue cycle billing sold to hospitals and physician practices, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Billing and customer care software for telecom and pay-TV operators; no healthcare product or customer overlap."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Free physician networking sold to pharma for marketing and trial recruitment; revenue comes from life sciences, not hospitals."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer service and knowledge software for contact centers; not healthcare IT sold to hospitals."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Patient experience surveys and benchmarking for hospitals; sells analytics, not EHR, revenue cycle or patient engagement software."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Pharma-funded messaging and patient savings programs; manufacturers pay, unlike hospital-paid EHR and billing services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Cloud payroll and HR management for employers across industries; not healthcare provider software or revenue cycle work."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Physician staffing contracts with hospitals that bill payers; a clinical services model, not hospital software or billing outsourcing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Diversified maker of medical, dental and infection products; hospital software and coding are a minor part of the business."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Cloud software for pharma and life sciences operations; customers and workflows differ from hospital EHR and revenue cycle."}]}
